name: Terminal Plugin
description: xterm.js PTY terminal emulator plugin. Creates a Terminal instance with Cockpit-themed colors (CSS-custom-property-derived background, foreground, cursor, selectionBackground). Uses FitAddon for container-relative sizing via ResizeObserver. Custom key handler: Ctrl+Shift+C copies selection to clipboard, Ctrl+Shift+V pastes from clipboard to PTY (avoids double-paste echo). Connects to node-pty backend via IPC (terminal:create/write/resize/kill). Listens for terminal:data (PTY output → xterm write) and terminal:exit (process death). Theme updates via updateTheme() re-read CSS vars. Scale is handled at PluginCard level (CSS transform) — no fontSize change needed.

interface.constructor: new TerminalPlugin(container: HTMLElement, uuid: string, cwd?: string)

methods.name: updateTheme
methods.description: Re-read CSS vars and update xterm theme

methods.name: setScale
methods.description: No-op — CSS transform handles canvas zoom

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Kill PTY, dispose xterm, disconnect ResizeObserver, remove element

properties.name: uuid
properties.description: Card UUID for PTY session identification
